text.p: Flood crests continue to move northward along the Red River in southern Manitoba, Canada, and should reach Winnepeg during the next few days, with the worst flooding in years expected. Rivers continue to recede slowly in and around the areas of Grand Forks and Fargo, North Dakota, with slow improvement. Generally dry with just a few light showers today-Saturday across the flood areas. The threat of heavier rainfal has diminished.
There are no further statements at this time.
